Then I guess I should give you the item that I've been protecting. You did well in coming here. It's locked up tight in the safe, so there's nothing to worry about. Now w…

Q00068_SagaOfTheSoulHound/2-02.htm.text: Warehouse Chief Mona: You don't have the Safe Key ? See Head Blacksmith Noel in Goddard Village!

Q00068_SagaOfTheSoulHound/2-03.htm.text: Warehouse Chief Mona: What took you so long? Did he make the key from scratch? Really? That must have been difficult; I bet Noel complained enough to raise the roof! Well, give me the key and I'll take out the item.

Q00068_SagaOfTheSoulHound/2-04.htm.text: Warehouse Chief Mona: Did you communicate with the Tablet of Vision located south of the Tower of Insolence ?

Q00068_SagaOfTheSoulHound/2-05.htm.text: Warehouse Chief Mona: I think I lost the key... We can't break into the safe, either. We have no choice -- you must go to Head Blacksmith Noel in the Town of Goddard and tell him that I need an extra key, and he will be able to give it to you. Simple, right? You'd best get going then!

Q00068_SagaOfTheSoulHound/2-06.htm.text: Warehouse Chief Mona: Here is the item that was deposited. It's called a Resonance Amulet. I heard that it activates a spell on the Tablet of Vision.
